primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best archive route because it keeps the complete game in a native release with 1080p presentation, broad input support, performance options, and capture/settings flexibility. Later PS4, iOS, and Switch ports provide useful access but no sourced exclusive gameplay content over PC.
